spots.name: Creamer's Field Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Creamer's Field MWR
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 163 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L128537.

spots.name: Smith Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. Pin moved to West UAF Trails & Smith Lake on the shore.

spots.name: Observation Tower
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Swim Beach
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.
